newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aetna EPS estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aetna EPS estimates cut.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Harry Fong reduced his earnings estimates for Aetna Inc to $0.95 per share from $1.15 for the third quarter, and to $4.30 from $4.70 for 1996, according to a research note obtained by Reuters.
-- shares fell 7/8 to 67 in late morning exchange trading.
-- Aetna said on Thursday it would restructure its health care and retirement services units, resulting in the elimination of 4,000 jobs in healthcare and charges in the third and fourth quarters.
